segments.title: A whole colony VANISHED
segments.say: In fifteen eighty-seven, a whole colony vanished. No one knows where.

segments.title: Roanoke Island, 1587
segments.say: English settlers started a colony on Roanoke Island.

segments.title: 3 years later: EMPTY
segments.sub: Their leader came back. **Everyone was gone.**
segments.say: Their leader, John White, came back about three years later. Everyone was gone.

segments.title: One clue: CROATOAN
segments.say: The only clues: the words Croatoan and Cro, carved into trees.

segments.title: Still unsolved
segments.say: Historians still argue about what happened.
